mechanism: Budesonide impairs intestinal calcium and vitamin D absorption and increases urinary calcium excretion, while chronic corticosteroid use reduces 1,25-dihydroxyvitamin D production, potentially reducing the efficacy of cholecalciferol supplementation.
action: Monitor serum calcium and vitamin D levels in patients on chronic budesonide therapy; consider higher cholecalciferol doses and ensure adequate calcium intake to prevent bone loss and secondary hyperparathyroidism.
